verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a first-party Connector SDK (Python) for building custom connectors for long-tail APIs, with a setup guide, GitHub repo, and even AI coding agent plugins for building/testing/deploying connectors via natural language — this is an official framework, not a fork. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer account of building a connector end-to-end, and no evidence of a true no-code/low-code builder (only SDK-based, code-first approach).
